CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

14. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey

15. Best practice when working on Athletics and Mosaic: (1 mark)

----
